scripts.copy:data: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const files=['items.json','heroes.json','abilities.json','hero_lore.json','hero_abilities.json','patchnotes.json'];const src='node_modules/dotaconstants/build';const dst='src/assets/data';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of files){const s=p.join(src,f);if(!fs.existsSync(s)){console.warn('missing: '+s);continue;}fs.copyFileSync(s,p.join(dst,f));console.log('copied '+f+' → '+dst);}"
scripts.build: npm run copy:data && npm run build:elements && npm run copy:elements && npm run build:app
